# Keenpix v0.3.1

Keenpix now ships the platform, Docker images, SDK, and framework integrations on one version from one repository tag.

## Highlights

- Unified all 35 release components on `0.3.1` and the single `v0.3.1` repository tag.
- Replaced package-specific GitHub releases with one release organized by component.
- Made npm publication dependency-aware and safe to rerun without republishing versions that already exist.
- Kept Docker publication manual while producing app, transform, worker, and docs images from the reviewed tag.

## Platform

### `@keenpix/app`

#### Improvements

- Aligned the control-plane application and its displayed version with the unified `v0.3.1` release.
- Added full repository health and package publication gates before a GitHub release can be created.

### `@keenpix/custom-domain-edge`

#### Maintenance

- Aligned the custom-domain edge component with the unified `v0.3.1` release line.

### `@keenpix/docs`

#### Improvements

- Published the standalone documentation image from the same reviewed `v0.3.1` source as the platform.

### `@keenpix/transform-app`

#### Improvements

- Published the image transformation data plane as `ghcr.io/lord007tn/keenpix-transform:v0.3.1`.
- Aligned shared transform and cache dependencies with the unified release.

### `@keenpix/worker`

#### Improvements

- Published the durable background worker as `ghcr.io/lord007tn/keenpix-worker:v0.3.1`.

## Public packages

### `@keenpix/core`

#### Features

- Added managed-cloud configuration helpers and complete source encoding for transform paths.
- Preserved display aspect ratios across responsive transform candidates.
- Published the shared framework contract at `0.3.1` for every integration.

### `@keenpix/sdk`

#### Features

- Added managed-cloud configuration helpers for server integrations.
- Added versioned, expiring transform URL signing and project watermark configuration.
- Published the management and prewarm SDK at the same `0.3.1` version as the framework family.

### Framework integrations

#### Maintenance

- Published every supported framework adapter at `0.3.1`, including Analog, Angular, Astro, Docusaurus, Eleventy, Ember, Expo, Fresh, Gatsby, HTML, Lit, Next.js, Nuxt, Preact, Qwik, React, React Native, Redwood, Remix, Solid, SolidStart, Svelte, SvelteKit, TanStack Start, Vite, VitePress, Vue, and Waku.
- Resolved internal framework-package dependencies to the same `0.3.1` release line.

## Upgrade notes

- Upgrade all Keenpix packages together to `0.3.1` so internal package contracts remain aligned.
- Pin production runtime images to `v0.3.1`; the production Compose defaults already use this tag.
- No package-specific Git tag is required. `v0.3.1` identifies the complete release.
